title: M5 Canonical Execution Error Taxonomy Specification

error_codes.message: Requested executor is not registered in ExecutorRegistry
error_codes.next_action: Specify a registered executor or register adapter before dispatch

error_codes.message: Registered executor adapter is offline or host unreachable
error_codes.next_action: Check executor host daemon status and retry

error_codes.message: Executor does not support the capabilities required by execution package
error_codes.next_action: Adjust package requirements or select compatible executor

error_codes.message: Execution package failed structural or semantic validation
Canonical role cannot be mapped by the target executor adapter
error_codes.next_action: Specify an authorized canonical role supported by adapter

error_codes.message: Executor adapter rejected the dispatch request
Dispatch operation timed out before acknowledgement from executor
Queried task identifier is not known to the executor adapter
Executor reported ambiguous or uncertain task state
error_codes.next_action: Run task reconciliation query to resolve state

error_codes.message: Task execution terminated with an error in the executor
error_codes.next_action: Inspect stderr summary and error details

error_codes.message: Task execution exceeded maximum allowed time limit
error_codes.next_action: Increase timeout constraint if task is long-running

error_codes.message: Task execution was cancelled by operator or timeout handler
error_codes.next_action: Re-dispatch as a fresh task if needed

error_codes.message: Target executor adapter does not support cancellation
error_codes.next_action: Wait for task to complete or restart host process

error_codes.message: Target executor adapter does not support resume operations
Malformed response or unexpected protocol error from executor host
Executor output could not be parsed into valid CanonicalResult
Internal error in core execution dispatcher or registry
error_codes.next_action: Inspect stack trace for dispatch defect
